bottom_line: The ratings mostly stand on fundamentals, but tonight is a poor time to start positions: CPI on Tuesday, a December Fed hike near 80% priced, CoreWeave earnings and the Nvidia CEO probe all land within days. Futures are only modestly higher after the worst week of the sell-off.
what_changed: US futures were modestly higher early Monday: S&P 500 E-minis about +0.4%, Nasdaq 100 about +0.2%, Dow about +0.7%, after a rough week (touches the 'crowded AI trade at high rates' thesis).
Nvidia fell about 4% premarket after its board opened a probe into CEO Jensen Huang; the worldview names this and the Nov. 11 congressional deadline as a risk to chip stocks.
October CPI (Tuesday) and CoreWeave earnings (Tuesday, options imply a ~20.7% swing) are the next tests of the rates and neocloud-credit theses.
No notable after-hours AI earnings turned up for tonight; the last big print was AMD on Nov. 3 (revenue +45%, data centre 64% of sales).

trust: No ratings are graded yet (grading starts after 28 days). The 36 picks so far average -7.7% against QQQ, and Buy/Overweight picks -6.1%, which is better than the whole universe (-6.2%) only marginally and behind QQQ.
if_buying: Overweight means a small starting position only; do not use a full-size position.
Prefer names in segments the worldview rates overweight (ETN, PWR, VRT) over STX, DELL and ASML.
If acting at the open, use limit orders: the first hour after a Monday gap in a VIX-23 market can swing widely.
Consider waiting until after Tuesday's CPI and CoreWeave results.
